notes.title: The Second "Steam version" Update
notes.notes:
This is the Tokyo Psychodemic Development Team.
We have updated the "Steam version" on Tuesday, June 25, 2024, at 20:00 JST.

Target: "Steam version"

[h2]Patch Note[/h2]
[h3]■ UI/UX Fixes[/h3]
1) Adjusted to allow selection of video tapes and cassette tapes from the PC folder
2) Fixed to allow verification of all evidence in the Dark Pit
3) Added an icon to indicate the active monitor on the analysis screen

[h3]■ Improved Usability for Steam Version[/h3]
4) Revised keyboard assignments

[h3]■ Enhanced Save Function[/h3]
5) Added auto-save feature
6) Added a feature to set auto-save slots arbitrarily

We will notify you again once the update schedule for the PS5 version, PS4 version, and Nintendo Switch version is confirmed.

Thank you for your support for "Tokyo Psychodemic."

notes.title: TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC Update
notes.notes:
As of June 14th 2024 19:00(JST) TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC has been updated to the latest version.

 
Update Target: Steam version

 
[h2]■Update Contents are as follows[/h2]
1）Implementation of automated text playback function and ability to change text display speed
2）Fast-forward function implemented in text function
3）Ability to access options mid scenario
4）Enabled double speed range for video playback

 
[h2]■Additional Update Contents[/h2]
・ Addition of Save/Load feature to the System Menu

 
A new announcement will be made at a future date for the above update on PS5, PS4, and Nintendo Switch versions.

We hope you'll continue to support TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC.

notes.title: TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC DEMO version has been released!
notes.notes:
Are you ready to take on paranormal cases using forensic science? Statistics show that around 5% of murder cases remain unresolved. Now it’s time to take on some of these unresolved mysteries. 
With the help of your colleagues, use your analytic tools and investigative abilities to crack the 
case.

The demo version will include a prologue to the very first chapter of the story. You will be 
provided with resources including live-action footage as well as an “evidence board” to help 
organize your deductions.
Enjoy an atmosphere unique to TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC, created through the combination of 2D 
graphics mixed with live-action footage.
